# Degraded Availability for MAI Code 2 Flash in Copilot

## What Changed

Nov 18, 09:34 UTC Resolved - On November 18, 2026, between 08:29 and 08:56 UTC, GitHub Copilot experienced degradation affecting the MAI Code 2 Flash model, causing elevated error rates for users. No other models were impacted, and users could continue using Copilot by selecting another model or Copilot Fusion. The degradation was caused by an infrastructure issue following a configuration change made while addressing an issue with an upstream model provider. We mitigated the incident by rebalancing load within our infrastructure, and service was restored by 08:56 UTC. GitHub is working to further improve the resiliency of the service to prevent similar incidents in the future. Nov 18, 09:34 UTC Update - The issues with our upstream model provider have been resolved, and MAI Code 2 Flash is once again available in Copilot products and IDE surfaces. We will continue monitoring to ensure stability, but mitigation is complete. Nov 18, 09:13 UTC Monitoring - The degradation affecting Copilot AI Model Providers has been mitigated.
